description: All-fp32-MultiHeadLut transformer at E=144, d_v=24. Q/K joint MultiHeadLut(in=144, n_heads=6, n_outputs=64=2*d_qk, in_nap=6, tph=256). V MultiHeadLut(in=144, n_heads=6, n_outputs=24=d_v, in_nap=6, tph=256). out_proj MultiHeadLut(in=144=H*d_v, n_heads=1, n_outputs=144=E, in_nap=8, tph=512). All smooth_mode=False, n_alternatives=1. After Q/K split: VectorToDominance(d_qk=32) on each half. After V: VectorToDominance(d_v=24). out_proj produces real-valued E-dim, followed by LayerNorm — block output is Euclidean (not pair-dominance). Concat 6 layer outputs (864) → LN + Linear unembedder. ~263 MB Adam params just in LUTs.
